verdict.rationale: Mercury Command supports bulk actions like bulk GL code assignment and creating categorization rules, and invoicing supports billing many customers, but true AI-native bulk operations via API/MCP ('every core Books action available programmatically', 'MCP layer... end-to-end') are explicitly framed as future ('Soon'), and probes show no live OpenAPI/MCP endpoints yet. missing for 10: confirmed live API/MCP for bulk operations, independent verification of bulk actions at scale, evidence of bulk operations beyond categorization/GL codes/invoicing.
